pages.text: I forgot how loud five people are.$(br2)We had the Fair today, first one in -- I want to say nine years, but Oda would correct me and she'd be right, she always is, she keeps the book.
pages.title: Entry Two

pages.text: Four stalls, and one of them was a plank on two barrels, and Pip sold flowers he had picked out of my own garden and charged me for them.$(br2)Bram got the wheel turning at noon. He stood there with his hands on his hips and said $(italic)well$(). That is the most emotional I have ever seen that man.
Write this down somewhere you'll find it in November, when it's dark and you're tired and you're wondering why you're bothering:$(br2)$(bold)It's this.$()$(br2)It was always going to be this.
